The evidence does not establish credential theft, malicious execution, or data theft attributable to alerted logon 0x677f081; the cited session process records show desktop initialization only (S22-00166, S22-00168).
additional_evidence_needed: None required for the present benign disposition. If stronger authorization assurance is required, obtain dev.sharma's confirmation of the 13:41:49 session and its purpose, using S22-00164 as the correlation point.
